title: Content JSON schemas + CI structural check (disclaimer + Tier-C back-translation presence)
context: The content files (phrase bank, allow-list, glossary, locale, provenance, review) need machine schemas and a CI structural check so malformed or non-conformant content fails fast. The schemas live in the agent-neutral core schema package, not adapters. The check also enforces the mandatory disclaimer and Tier-C back-translation presence.
objective: Add the content JSON schemas and a CI structural check that fails on malformed or non-conformant content.
acceptanceCriteria: Adds phraseBankSchema, allowListSchema, glossarySchema, localeSchema, provenanceSchema, reviewSchema to packages/schema/src/schemas.ts, compiled via validate.ts (AJV + ajv-formats)
Structural-check script parses YAML to JSON and fails CI on malformed/non-conformant files
Fails CI on a pack missing the mandatory disclaimer and on a Tier-C phrase lacking a back-translation record
Wired into pnpm test; agent-neutral (in the core schema package, not adapters)
